grammar.title: Sequencing with 首先...然后
grammar.pattern: 首先 + 第一步，然后 + 第二步
grammar.explanation: 首先 (shǒuxiān) means "first of all" and introduces the first step of a process; 然后 (ránhòu) then introduces what comes next. Together they help you lay out instructions or a story in clear order.

grammar.title: At least with 至少
grammar.explanation: 至少 (zhìshǎo) means "at least" — it sets a minimum amount, time, or degree, showing that the real number could be higher. It usually comes right before the quantity or requirement it's describing.

sentences.zh: 面对困难，他一直很努力。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì kùnnan, tā yīzhí hěn nǔlì.
sentences.en: Facing difficulty, he always works hard.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de xiāngdāng hǎo.
sentences.en: His Chinese is spoken quite well.
